# Strength plan, three days a week

Monday: squat 5x5, bench press 3x8, barbell row 3x8. Wednesday: deadlift 1x5, overhead press 3x8, pull-ups to failure.
Friday: front squat 3x5, incline dumbbell press, farmer carries. Add 2.5 kg when every set is finished. Deload week
every fourth week at 60 % of the working weights.
